# IVCAP Lambda SDK (Python)

> Python SDK for building lambda-style services on the IVCAP platform — register tool functions as HTTP endpoints, handle async job execution, report progress, and expose MCP endpoints for AI agents

ivcap_lambda is a Python SDK for building lambda-style services on the IVCAP
(Intelligent Visual Computing and Analytics Platform). It extends ivcap_service
and provides HTTP scaffolding via FastAPI for registering tool functions as
endpoints, handling async job execution with try-later semantics, reporting
progress events, and optionally exposing an MCP endpoint for AI agent tooling.
